title: Can I BEAT 4 Player Chess? (again)
summary: Tony plays chess.com 4 Player Chess (free-for-all) against three humans (Red ~2000, Blue ~1500, Green ~2200; Tony is Yellow). Players move clockwise starting with Red, scoring points for captures; checkmate = 20 points. Final ranking: 1st = 3 wins, 2nd = 1 win, 3rd = 1 loss, 4th = 3 losses. Goal: 'three wins' (1st place). He takes 1st place in game 1.
rules: 4-player free-for-all on the 14x14 cross-shaped board (8x8 core plus 3-wide arms; 3x3 corners removed).
Turn order clockwise: Red, Blue, Yellow, Green.
Points for capturing pieces; checkmating a player = 20 points.
Pawns promote when they cross the small grey dot in the centre (the board's middle, equidistant for all).

board.shape_notes: cross/plus shape: 14x14 with 3x3 corners cut out; grey dot at centre marks promotion line
board.theme_notes: chess.com 4 Player Chess board with red, blue, yellow, green armies; in-game chat

setup: chess.com 4PC FFA start: each colour on one arm (Red bottom, Blue left, Yellow top, Green right), back rank R N B Q K B N R / K-Q swapped for two sides as in chess.com
visual_fx: Thumbnail: '2 Players' (black/white kings) vs '4 Players' (red, green, blue, yellow kings)
